subject: Made-to-measure alcove cabinetry
hook: My alcove walls are wonky. Can you still fit a unit?
fb:
"My walls are all over the place. Is there any point getting fitted alcove units?"

We hear this a lot, especially in older terraces and cottages. The good news: uneven walls are completely normal, and they're exactly why made-to-measure furniture exists.

We measure each alcove at several heights to see how the walls lean. The cabinet itself is built square in our Hanley workshop so the doors hang properly. Then on site, a filler panel is scribed to follow your wall's exact shape, so there's no gap from floor to top.

Got a question about your alcoves? Ask below or send us a message.

gbp:
My alcove walls aren't straight. Will a fitted unit still fit?

Yes. Uneven walls are normal, particularly in older homes, and made-to-measure alcove units are designed with that in mind.

When SUPERIO surveys your room, we measure each alcove at several heights to understand how the walls lean. The cabinets are built square in our own workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, so doors hang straight. On site, our team scribes a filler panel to follow the shape of your wall, closing the gap from floor to top in the same finish as the unit.

Start with a free, no-obligation design consultation. Tap Learn more to see our made-to-measure furniture.
